Build a SNARE-ONLY pseudo-non-immobilizer: a synthetic profile with total_pa PINNED inside the non-immobilizer band (target |total_pa| <= the frozen trans-DCE / hexafluoroethane max |total_pa| at any tested dose, i.e. effectively ~0 current shift) while ONLY snare_cooperativity is engaged (driven to its strongest realizable engagement across the Eger dose grid). PRECONDITION (positive control): a SNARE-lever-sufficiency probe must show SNARE-max moves QF by >= 0.2 from the snare-off baseline at matched total_pa; if it does NOT, the falsifier is UNINTERPRETABLE (the synaptic lever is inert in this substrate -- report honestly, fall back to the Part-A demonstration).
